title: Implement CFA3-native shared CUDA compatibility translation
goal: Provide one CFA3-owned CUDA-oriented source compatibility and translation core to every current and future CFA3 application, targeting AMD and Intel through existing native/portable execution backends without any Spectral Compute SCALE build or runtime dependency.
requirements: CUDA is a backend interface, not a capability.
The implementation is one central shared CFA3-native core available to every current and future CFA3 application.
Spectral Compute SCALE must not be a build dependency, runtime dependency, binary-loading dependency, or activation requirement.
Application-local CUDA compatibility or translation cores are forbidden.
AMD translation targets the admitted ROCm/HIP execution path.
Intel translation targets admitted Level Zero/OpenCL execution paths.
CUDA source feature coverage must be analyzed per workload and unsupported semantics must fail closed with a user-visible limitation.
Closed CUDA binaries, PTX, CUBIN and FATBIN are not claimed by the initial implementation.
Translation execution must be explicitly allowed by workload policy.
HRB remains placement and lease authority.
Native NVIDIA CUDA remains available independently and is not replaced.
No silent backend, device, provider or cloud fallback.
Physical Current Host or target-host evidence is required before runtime promotion.
Capability baseline remains 175 with no new architectural authority.
